source.book: An Intimate Note to the Sincere Seeker — Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar

slides.text: What if the thing you're chasing is what's keeping happiness away?
Desire kills joy. And yet every desire is aimed at joy.
No one has ever wished for *unhappiness*. Not once, not ever.
So when joy disappears, look closer. Desire is usually hiding right there.
The one who masters desire is called a conqueror
slides.cta: Not because they got everything. Because they stopped needing to.
